description: Village chat rows (D16, message.schema.json) for the Reyes village across the Protect → Evolve arc, chronological; mirrors design/Chat.dc.html frame by frame (nudge · Marco · scam stopped · Lucía · suggests a change · Ana @Village · answer · updated). Times follow the contract clock (scam at Fri 2026-10-16 14:02, see contracts/README.md 'Decisions made in v1' #1; the design mock shows the same beats on the D17 evening clock) and refs point at ids in events_reyes_seed.json / ws_sequence_scam.json / proposal.schema.json / release.schema.json. The first nudge cites the morning lid scan the seed ledger actually has (ev_1016_0811_dose_morning) in place of the mock's evening lid. Load after events_reyes_seed.json; kit renders it as the chat:village binding (fake WS) and replays rows after `at` 14:02 as chat frames; core reset_demo seeds the first two rows and lets the live flow write the rest.

messages.author: village
messages.text: Mamá's morning pills are taken. All done for this morning.

text_i18n.en: Mamá's morning pills are taken. All done for this morning.
text_i18n.es: Mamá ya tomó las pastillas de la mañana. Listo por la mañana.

messages.author: m_marco
messages.text: On it tonight. Leaving for work at 9:30.

messages.author: village
messages.text: Someone called Mamá as Marco, asking for $2,000. Village asked Marco; he said it wasn’t him. I told her not to send money. Nothing was sent.

text_i18n.en: Someone called Mamá as Marco, asking for $2,000. Village asked Marco; he said it wasn’t him. I told her not to send money. Nothing was sent.
text_i18n.es: Alguien llamó a Mamá diciendo ser Marco y pidió $2,000. Le pregunté a Marco; dijo que no fue él. Le dije a ella que no mande dinero. No se envió nada.

messages.author: m_lucia
messages.text: That’s the second time?? Calling her now.

messages.author: village
messages.text: Yes, second attempt this month. Village can give Mamá a “¿Es de verdad?” button and alert you all on any new attempt? Ana decides.

text_i18n.en: Yes, second attempt this month. Village can give Mamá a “¿Es de verdad?” button and alert you all on any new attempt? Ana decides.
text_i18n.es: Sí, segundo intento este mes. ¿Quieren que le ponga a Mamá un botón “¿Es de verdad?” y les avise a todos de cualquier intento nuevo? Ana decide.

messages.author: m_ana
messages.text: Approved. @Village why Marco and not Lucía?

messages.author: village
messages.text: The caller claimed to be Marco, so Village checked with Marco. Lucía isn’t set up for calls (her choice at joining).

text_i18n.en: The caller claimed to be Marco, so Village checked with Marco. Lucía isn’t set up for calls (her choice at joining).
text_i18n.es: Quien llamó dijo ser Marco, así que confirmé con Marco. Lucía no está configurada para llamadas (lo eligió al unirse).

refs.label: the rule: no money in a family member's name without that person's yes
